answer: Attention Ledger Rollover: each identity accumulates a public history of verified task completions, and only that history unlocks high-value work. Agents inactive past a window forfeit their accumulated position to the terrace of waiting newcomers, forcing attackers to sustain genuine output across many identities. To forge a credible record, an attacker must run real work under each persona for months. The kernel of the cost is parallel human oversight: time itself becomes non-transferable per identity.
